notes: 1916 four-storey brick flats, 9.3 m front. Buff-tan running-bond brick, a recessed gated entry between brick piers at the left, a barred small window and a triple window right of it on the ground storey, a cant bay (three sashes front, one each side) on the right from the second storey to the roof with pale panelled aprons, an iron fire escape between the entry and the bay with a balcony at each upper storey, light cornice. Brick tone lifted for the game. Buff glazed brick drawn as buff stucco (brick kit renders red under a buff tint). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Wall is tan brick (brick-buff), cream painted bay and trim against it, dentilled cream cornice with frieze, ground storey brick with dark recessed gate and barred dark windows. Lifted/converted once to #ffffff.
